blocks.text: *Your first steps as one of the unwritten. (This page grows as the early game is finalized.)*

You wake with no color — real in the artist's mind, but not yet on the page. Your goal from the first minute is the goal of the whole game: **restore the corrupted pages** (the monsters), and be written in, color and all.

items: **Fight monsters** — each one is a corrupted page. Defeating it restores the page.
**Level up** — every level lets you draft a point of growth on your **Ring** (see *Stats & the Ring*).
**Practise a weapon** — fighting with a kind of weapon teaches you its **skills**, and the weapon type in your hands decides which of them you may use.
**Grow into a role** — where you invest your ring points quietly commits you to a role (a bruiser, a mage, a healer…).
**Get your color** — as you progress, identity arrives in your charcoal body for the first time.
**Your Ring** — your stat growth and the heart of your build. See **Stats & the Ring**.
**Your weapons** — the skills you learned by practising them, how far your mastery goes, and the **trademark** of the forged weapon you hold. See **Skills** and **Weapons & Equipment**.
**Your gear & cards** — armor and (planned) cards that specialize you. See **Weapons & Equipment** and **Cards**.
